items.question: Are the ID photos compliant with Hong Kong government / Immigration Department standards?
items.answer: Our system is designed to match official Hong Kong passport and ID card dimensions (photo size, head proportion, etc.). For best results, face the camera directly, keep eyes open, no teeth showing, and ears clearly visible.

items.question: What is a 4R print layout?
items.answer: A 4R layout automatically arranges multiple standard ID photos on one 4×6 inch (4R) print sheet. You pay for a single 4R print at a photo kiosk or convenience store and cut out multiple ID photos — extremely cost-effective!

items.question: How long does the whole process take?
items.answer: From upload to download takes about 1 minute — no waiting in line at a photo booth.
